description: Monitors Google News coverage for a brand using apidojo's Google Search scraper on Apify. Triggers when the user asks to: track news coverage about a brand on Google, monitor press mentions in Google News, find recent news articles mentioning a company, track media coverage for a brand or executive, monitor competitor news coverage, find press releases or news stories about a brand on Google, or research how a company is being covered in the press. Returns article title, publication, date, URL, and coverage sentiment per article. Ideal for PR agencies, communications teams, brand managers, and reputation monitoring services.
